# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.
# [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2025#60702-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2025#60699-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2025#60698-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.
# There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2025#60702-spectator-limit).

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2025#60699-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2025#60698-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information:
¡Llega a Puebla el torneo CUBING BUAP!
Un encuentro único donde los mejores speedcubers del país (tú podrías ser uno de ellos) demostrarán su talento en una competencia de precisión, velocidad y estrategia.
La categoría principal será nada más y nada menos que el legendario 3x3, el clásico que lo inició todo. Un cubo, seis colores y una sola meta: ¡resolverlo en el menor tiempo posible! 
Si eres un cubero experto que busca romper su récord o si estás dando tus primeros giros y quieres vivir la emoción de la competencia, CUBING BUAP es el escenario perfecto para ti.
Habrá premios, regalos, emoción, y por supuesto… ¡muchos cubos girando al mismo tiempo! 

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEwMzI1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3f71e2a1b95fa4fafef2e35ef0a08955e9e0e708/LOGO%20OFICIAL%20CUBING%20BUAP.png)

The CUBING BUAP tournament is coming to Puebla!
A unique gathering where the country's best speed cubers (you could be one of them) will showcase their talent in a competition of precision, speed, and strategy.
The main category will be none other than the legendary 3x3, the classic that started it all. One cube, six colors, and one goal: solve it in the shortest time possible!
Whether you're an expert cuber looking to break your record or are just taking your first spins and want to experience the thrill of competition, CUBING BUAP is the perfect venue for you.
There will be prizes, giveaways, excitement, and of course... lots of cubes spinning at the same time!

**To je samo FMC tekmovanje slovenskega državnega prvenstva 2025!** Za ostale discipline preverite tekmovanje [Slovenian Nationals 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovenianNationals2025).
Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija.
Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

Za več informacij preverite zavihke!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2hiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4e3eff62ae7d9d9a76dea175436b619568f5b8f2/EN.png)

Competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija.
If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

For more information, please check the tabs!

items.name: Quiet by the Kings OH 2025
items.information:
This competition takes place on **SATURDAY** and only features Square-1, FMC, and Blindfolded events. Therefore, it may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingbytheKingsOH2025) to view the page for the Cubing by the Kings OH 2025 competition which does feature 3x3, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. 

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)

Quiet by the Kings OH 2025 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org)
